La crème est très facile à appliquer et semble bien nourrissante. L'odeur est agréable. À voir à l'usage si les résultats sont à la hauteur de ce qui est dit partout, trop tôt pour le dire encore

avis.titre: Très bonne crème jour et nuit
avis.texte: Meilleur crème que je connaisse ,pour l'hydratation, les rides ! Je recommande

avis.titre: Repeat Purchase – Highly RecommendRepeat Purchase – Highly Recommend
avis.texte: I absolutely love this face cream—it's my new favourite! I use it as my night cream because it's so moisturising and nourishing. I can really tell I've used it, as even the next morning my skin looks radiant and feels soft and hydrated. The scent is lovely too - just really pleasant and enjoyable to use. This is a repeat purchase for me, I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a rich, nourishing face cream.

avis.titre: Yes, I like it a lot!
avis.texte: Helps my skin, it's more firm and more hydrated! My first retinol face cream and it didn't disappoint!

avis.titre: Improved my skin texture in one tube
avis.texte: Just bought my second tube of this cream. I am so pleased with the results on my skin. I have somewhat large pores and an acne scar on my face that looks like a small pit. I noticed after using this cream for a while that the scar was less noticeable and the pores were smaller. By the time I was through the whole tube, I swear the scar is practically gone and my skin looks so good. I don't believe the retinol alternative is backuchiol but whatever it is, it's been great for me. I use the regular Embryolisse at night with a hyaluronic acid serum, and between these two products my skin looks radiant. And I'm in my early 60s! Highly recommend this if you are looking for a retinol alternative.

avis.titre: If I Could Only Keep One Brand, It Would Be This One
avis.texte: First of all, I love this brand. I have tons of their products and I've used every single one down to the last drop — which is a great sign of true quality. I adore the packaging too: the pretty, simple aluminum tubes are so practical. The prices are very fair as well. Embryolisse is a "little" French brand that really deserves to be better known, and I'm so happy you can now find it in pharmacies here in Canada. If I had to throw out every product in my bathroom, the one I'd keep is Embryolisse Lait-Crème!
